deployments_detail.use: Fukuoka Bank deployed LayerX Ai Workforce for contract-document management in structured finance (project finance, real estate finance, LBO, ship/aircraft finance); rolled out from HQ to branches. First regional bank in Japan to adopt it. [LayerX (Ai Workforce)]

Partnership with OpenAI adopting ChatGPT Enterprise, OpenAI o1 (for code and design-document creation), and custom GPTs; used by engineers to streamline coding and non-technical staff for data analysis. First regional Japanese bank to partner with OpenAI. [OpenAI (ChatGPT Enterprise, o1, GPTs)]
OpenAI partnership (Mar 2025) for financial ops efficiency + generative AI value creation; dedicated AI Strategy Group est. Apr 2024

Generative AI to auto-draft the opinion section of loan credit approval documents (ringi-sho); extracts borrower data from CRM/Excel and generates drafts loan officers refine. Rolled out to all Fukuoka Bank branches after a Fukuoka-city pilot. [IBM Japan; middleware supports GPT or Claude interchangeably]
Loan business generative AI (ringi-sho creation support) developed with IBM; PoC then pilot at select branches, phased rollout, with plans for a proprietary LLM. [IBM Japan]

Shinsa Support AI (審査サポートAI) supporting loan review/screening work in corporate lending; internal use launched across branches with caravan adoption activities. Built to convert tacit credit-assessment knowledge into structured support. [PwC Consulting; development support by Adniss]

Strategic partnership deploying exaBase Studio, an AI-agent development/operations platform with RAG Ops templates, for head-office operational reform, sales/market productivity, and compliance/risk management. Phased implementation across the group. [ExaWizards (exaBase Studio)]
deployments_detail.value: 90% of FFG-proposed AI use cases match existing platform templates

deployments_detail.use: Loan review support AI + loan proposal document generation AI in core lending ops (with PwC / IBM)
FFG adopted Salesforce as a data- and AI-driven sales-reform and information-sharing platform blending offline and online channels across the group. [Salesforce]
Plan to build a system by FY2027 where AI advises on customers' cash-flow/funding consultations and recommends sales approaches for bankers based on data. [none named]
Minna Bank (FFG subsidiary) uses AI to monitor and detect fraudulent/suspicious bank accounts (e.g., accounts opened with stolen personal data) with high precision. [Groovenauts]

Minna Bank uses generative AI to streamline anti-money-laundering suspicious-transaction reporting (data aggregation, file organization, document generation, PDF processing); Gemini Enterprise deployed enterprise-wide after successful pilot. [Google Cloud (Gemini / Gemini Enterprise) with RPA/Python]
deployments_detail.value: ~47% work-hour reduction; one 7-hour task cut to ~30 seconds
